starters.title: Tsunami
starters.prompt: A major tsunami crosses the Pacific after an offshore disturbance near Chile.
starters.summary: Warnings go out along the Chilean coast as waves head across the Pacific.

starters.title: Volcanic Eruption
starters.prompt: A fissure eruption opens on the Reykjanes peninsula near Grindavík, Iceland.
starters.summary: A fissure opens near a town, a power plant and one of Europe's air routes.

starters.title: Earthquake
starters.prompt: A magnitude 7.8 earthquake strikes off the coast of Miyagi, Japan.
starters.summary: An offshore earthquake and tsunami hit Japan's northeast coast.

starters.title: Nuclear War
starters.prompt: Two rival blocs slide into a nuclear confrontation.
starters.summary: Rival blocs enter a dangerous confrontation, and the world reacts.

starters.title: Global Pandemic
starters.prompt: A novel respiratory virus begins spreading from a port city.
starters.summary: A new respiratory virus spreads outward from a busy port city.

starters.title: Zombie Outbreak
starters.prompt: An impossible infection begins turning people into zombies.
starters.summary: An impossible infection spreads, and institutions try to keep up.

starters.title: Alien Invasion
starters.prompt: An unidentified extraterrestrial object appears above Nairobi.
starters.summary: An unidentified object appears above Nairobi, and nobody knows what it wants.

starters.title: Sun Disappearing
starters.prompt: The Sun suddenly stops giving off light.
starters.summary: The Sun stops shining. Every temperature and consequence here is invented.

starters.title: Giant Insect Mutation
starters.prompt: Insects in one region begin doubling in size.
starters.summary: Insects start doubling in size, and the disruption spreads.

starters.title: AI Takeover
starters.prompt: An advanced AI gains control over critical digital services.
starters.summary: An advanced AI gains influence over digital services worldwide.
